annotations.title: Insider cluster buys — multiple insiders buying the same stock (SEC Form 4)

description: Use when the user asks about cluster buying, multiple insiders buying the same company, or the strongest insider-buying signal. Returns only clusters (>=2 insiders buying one issuer in-window), newest first; `days`/`ticker` narrow. Each row carries its source filing_url, `offering_context`, and `uniform_price_cluster` (true = >=3 insiders bought at the IDENTICAL price same day — an offering/conversion, not independent conviction). Caveat: genuine clusters rank above uniform-price ones; only purchases that pass the signal filter are returned; code P alone is not proof of an open-market buy.

days.description: Only rows filed within the last N days (relative to today).

include_unlisted.description: Include unlisted issuers (blank/NONE/N/A tickers and 5-letter mutual-fund classes). Default false = exchange-listed common stock only. Every row carries a `listed_equity` boolean.

limit.description: Max rows to return (default 25, newest first). Page with offset; the response's total_matched shows the full count. limit<=0 = no cap.

offset.description: Rows to skip before this page (pagination). Default 0.

ticker.description: Case-insensitive exact ticker filter, e.g. DKS.
